fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Off: disabled. Shadow: run in background, log results, never apply. Advise: show decision hint to LLM, LLM retains choice. Enforce: apply decision, ignore LLM output for this choice.

fields.description: Optional override of the surface default latency budget in milliseconds.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Lower numbers have higher priority when multiple bindings match the same surface.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to temporarily disable this binding without deleting it.
